title: A chord-to-arc chain and the sector inversion

board_content.text: Diameter $40$ cm gives $r=20$. A chord of $20$ cm; the perpendicular from the centre bisects it.
Two unknowns from two conditions — the JEE Advanced pattern: easy trig, hard algebra.

segments_english.text: Example five chains two ideas: a chord relation, then the arc formula.

A circle of diameter forty gives radius twenty. A chord is twenty centimetres long. Drop a perpendicular from the centre; it bisects the chord, leaving a right triangle with hypotenuse twenty and half-chord ten.
So sine of theta over two equals ten over twenty, which is one half. That means theta over two is pi over six, so theta is pi over three.
Now the arc: s equals r theta, twenty times pi over three, which is twenty pi over three, about twenty point nine four centimetres.
Example six looks the hardest but the trig is trivial — it's an algebra puzzle in disguise.

A sector has perimeter sixteen and area sixteen. Perimeter is two radii plus the arc: two r plus s equals sixteen. Area is one half r squared theta equals sixteen, so r squared theta is thirty two, and since s equals r theta, s equals thirty two over r.

Substitute into the perimeter: two r plus thirty two over r equals sixteen. Clear it and you get r minus four, all squared, equals zero. So r is four, s is eight, and theta is s over r, which is two radians.
Notice the design: two unknowns pinned down by two conditions. The angle work is child's play; the difficulty is the algebra. That's the signature JEE Advanced move.

segments_hinglish.text: Example पाँच दो ideas को chain करता है: पहले chord relation, फिर arc formula.
Diameter चालीस वाले circle का radius बीस. Chord बीस centimetres लंबा है. Centre से perpendicular गिराइए; वो chord को bisect करता है, बनता है right triangle जिसका hypotenuse बीस और half-chord दस.
So sine of theta over two equals ten over twenty, यानी one half. मतलब theta over two is pi over six, so theta is pi over three.
अब arc: s equals r theta, twenty times pi over three, यानी twenty pi over three, करीब twenty point nine four centimetres.
Example छह सबसे मुश्किल दिखता है पर trig मामूली है, ये असल में algebra की पहेली है.

एक sector का perimeter सोलह और area सोलह. Perimeter है two radii plus arc: two r plus s equals sixteen. Area है one half r squared theta equals sixteen, so r squared theta is thirty two, और s equals r theta से s equals thirty two over r.
Perimeter में डालिए: two r plus thirty two over r equals sixteen. साफ़ करने पर r minus four, whole squared, equals zero. So r चार, s आठ, और theta equals s over r, यानी two radians.
Design देखिए: दो unknowns, दो conditions से fix. Angle का काम बच्चों जैसा; मुश्किल algebra है. यही signature J E E Advanced move है.
